name: welch_power_spectral_density
decomposition_rationale: Welch's method decomposes into framing, periodogram calculation per windowed frame, and averaging across frames. This separation allows reusing the STFT or frame-level FFT atoms.

atomic_nodes.name: compute_frame_periodograms
atomic_nodes.semantic_role: Computes the squared magnitude of the windowed FFT for each frame to obtain the periodogram.

inputs.name: window_norm
inputs.constraints: Energy norm of the window function

atomic_nodes.witness_shape_semantics: Converts complex spectrum to real power values of the same shape.
atomic_nodes.complexity_reasoning: Element-wise squaring of magnitude for k frames of length m.

atomic_nodes.name: average_periodograms
atomic_nodes.semantic_role: Averages periodograms across all frames to reduce spectral variance.
atomic_nodes.witness_shape_semantics: Collapses the temporal/frame dimension of length K to return a single 1D power spectrum.
atomic_nodes.complexity_reasoning: Reduces across the frame dimension by averaging.
